big_case.notes: Single-station technical refusal-to-bargain challenge to a union certification resolved in an unpublished Second Circuit summary order on record-specific substantial-evidence grounds, after the Second Circuit had already adopted Loper Bright non-deference for NLRB legal conclusions in Siren Retail Corp. v. NLRB (Sept. 2, 2026). The petition drew an SG waiver, zero amicus briefs, one conference distribution, and an unexplained denial.
